{{< include _approx-note.qmd >}}

All figures sum over the `r length(valid_iso3)` producing countries that pass the
[data checks](coverage.qmd). The input data for 1995–2000 are subject to larger
uncertainties; trends are best read from 2000–2005 onwards ([method](method.qmd)).

## From loss to footprint

Three steps narrow the observed loss down to the footprint: gross natural loss
(*unconstrained*), the part that coincides with agricultural expansion in the same cell
(*agriculture-constrained*), and finally the share of it that is linked to German
final demand (*BF-NEE*).

```{r}
#| label: fig-cascade
#| fig-cap: !expr 'cap("Gross loss of natural ecosystems (unconstrained), net expansion of agricultural land (cropland plus intensive pasture) and agriculture-constrained loss per five-year period, in km². The constrained loss is the part of the gross loss that coincides with agricultural expansion in the same grid cell and period, capped at the size of the expansion.")'
#| fig-height: 4.6
cascade <- global_period %>%
  select(period,
         `Unconstrained natural loss` = loss_unconstrained_km2,
         `Agricultural expansion` = agri_gain_km2,
         `Agriculture-constrained loss` = loss_constrained_km2) %>%
  pivot_longer(-period, names_to = "measure", values_to = "km2") %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = c("Unconstrained natural loss",
                                              "Agricultural expansion",
                                              "Agriculture-constrained loss")))

p <- ggplot(cascade, aes(period, km2, fill = measure,
                         text = paste0(measure, "<br>", period, ": ", fmt_km2(km2)))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75,
           colour = bf_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = measure_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_area, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))) +
  labs(title = "Natural ecosystem loss and agricultural expansion",
       subtitle = "Sum over all valid producing countries",
       x = NULL, y = "Area (km²)")

bf_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-share-attributed
#| fig-cap: !expr 'cap("Share of the gross natural ecosystem loss that coincides with agricultural expansion in the same grid cell and period (agriculture-constrained loss divided by unconstrained loss), per five-year period.")'
#| fig-height: 3.8
p <- ggplot(global_period, aes(period, share_attributed, group = 1,
                               text = paste0(period, ": ", fmt_pct(share_attributed)))) +
  geom_line(colour = bf_brand$primary) +
  geom_point(colour = bf_brand$primary, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_pct, limits = c(0, NA),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  labs(title = "Share of natural loss that coincides with agricultural expansion",
       subtitle = "Agriculture-constrained loss / unconstrained loss",
       x = NULL, y = NULL)

bf_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-loss-basis
#| fig-cap: !expr 'cap("Agriculture-constrained loss split into the part linked to cropland expansion and the part linked to intensive pasture expansion, in km². The split is made in every grid cell in proportion to the positive area changes of the two land uses; the tooltip shows each part’s share of the period total.")'
#| eval: !expr has_pasture
#| fig-height: 4.4
basis <- global_period %>%
  select(period,
         `Cropland` = loss_cropland_km2,
         `Intensive pasture` = loss_pasture_km2) %>%
  pivot_longer(-period, names_to = "basis", values_to = "km2") %>%
  group_by(period) %>% mutate(share = km2 / sum(km2)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(basis = factor(basis, levels = names(basis_colors)))

p <- ggplot(basis, aes(period, km2, fill = basis,
                       text = paste0(basis, "<br>", period, ": ", fmt_km2(km2),
                                     " (", fmt_pct(share), ")"))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = bf_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = basis_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_area, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(title = "Agriculture-constrained loss by land use",
       subtitle = "Split per grid cell by the expansion of cropland vs. intensive pasture",
       x = NULL, y = "Area (km²)")

bf_interactive(p)
```

## BF-NEE over time

```{r}
#| label: fig-bfnee-time
#| fig-cap: !expr 'cap("BF-NEE per five-year period in km²: the agriculture-constrained loss weighted with the share of each producing country’s crop and livestock production that is used for German final demand. Hover for the number of countries.")'
#| fig-height: 4.2
p <- ggplot(global_period, aes(period, bfnee_km2, group = 1,
                               text = paste0(period, ": ", fmt_km2(bfnee_km2),
                                             "<br>", n_countries, " countries"))) +
  geom_area(fill = measure_colors[["BF-NEE"]], alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_line(colour = measure_colors[["BF-NEE"]]) +
  geom_point(colour = measure_colors[["BF-NEE"]], size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_area, limits = c(0, NA),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  labs(title = "BF-NEE: loss attributed to German final demand",
       subtitle = "Sum over all valid producing countries",
       x = NULL, y = "BF-NEE (km²)")

bf_interactive(p)
```

### By ecosystem group

```{r}
#| label: fig-bfnee-eco
#| fig-cap: !expr 'cap("BF-NEE per period split by ecosystem group, in km². The constrained loss of each grid cell is distributed onto the natural ecosystem classes in proportion to their gross loss, so the groups add up to the total. The group Modified (counted as natural) contains degraded former forest (IUCN 14.6), introduced vegetation and unclassified cover.")'
#| fig-height: 4.8
eco_period <- ce %>%
  group_by(period, eco_group) %>%
  summarise(bfnee_km2 = sum(bfnee_km2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  mutate(share = bfnee_km2 / sum(bfnee_km2)) %>%
  ungroup()

p <- ggplot(eco_period, aes(period, bfnee_km2, fill = eco_group,
                            text = paste0(eco_group, "<br>", period, ": ",
                                          fmt_km2(bfnee_km2), " (", fmt_pct(share), ")"))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = bf_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = eco_group_colors, name = NULL, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_area, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(title = "BF-NEE by ecosystem group",
       subtitle = "Ecosystem-specific footprints add up to the total",
       x = NULL, y = "BF-NEE (km²)")

bf_interactive(p)
```

More detail on the [Ecosystems](ecosystems.qmd) page.

p <- ggplot(bb, aes(period, km2, fill = basis,

## Effect of the agricultural constraint

How much smaller is BF-NEE when only loss linked to agricultural expansion is
attributed, compared with attributing all natural loss?

```{r}
#| label: fig-constraint
#| fig-cap: !expr 'cap("BF-NEE with the agricultural-expansion constraint compared with a variant that attributes the entire gross natural ecosystem loss with the same weights, in km². The difference is the loss that is not attributed because it does not coincide with agricultural expansion.")'
#| fig-height: 4
comp <- global_period %>%
  select(period, `BF-NEE (constrained)` = bfnee_km2,
         `Without constraint` = bfnee_unconstrained_km2) %>%
  pivot_longer(-period, names_to = "variant", values_to = "km2") %>%
  mutate(variant = factor(variant, levels = c("Without constraint", "BF-NEE (constrained)")))

p <- ggplot(comp, aes(period, km2, fill = variant,
                      text = paste0(variant, "<br>", period, ": ", fmt_km2(km2)))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75,
           colour = bf_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Without constraint" = bf_ink$other,
                               "BF-NEE (constrained)" = measure_colors[["BF-NEE"]]),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_area, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))) +
  labs(title = "BF-NEE with and without the agricultural-expansion constraint",
       x = NULL, y = "BF-NEE (km²)")

bf_interactive(p)
```

## Effect of treating plantations as anthropogenic {#plantations}

Since v3.1, plantations (IUCN 14.3) and artificial aquatic classes no longer count
as natural ecosystems. Until the pipeline can be rerun, their share is removed from
the v3 results; the exact values lie between the two bars of each period.

```{r}
#| label: fig-plantations
#| fig-cap: !expr 'cap("Global BF-NEE per period in the v3 results, in which plantations and artificial aquatic classes still counted as natural ecosystems, and in the v3.1 approximation, in which their share is removed, in km². The v3.1 value is a lower bound; the exact value lies between the two bars. The tooltip shows the relative change.", v31 = FALSE)'
#| eval: !expr '!is.null(country_transition_v3)'
#| fig-height: 4
v3_tot <- country_transition_v3 %>%
  filter(iso3 %in% valid_iso3) %>%
  mutate(period = factor(transition_label(transition), levels = periods)) %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(`v3 (plantations counted as natural)` = sum(bfnee_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

pl <- global_period %>%
  select(period, `v3.1 approximation` = bfnee_km2) %>%
  left_join(v3_tot, by = "period") %>%
  mutate(change = `v3.1 approximation` / `v3 (plantations counted as natural)` - 1) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(`v3 (plantations counted as natural)`, `v3.1 approximation`),
               names_to = "variant", values_to = "km2") %>%
  mutate(variant = factor(variant, levels = c("v3 (plantations counted as natural)",
                                              "v3.1 approximation")))

p <- ggplot(pl, aes(period, km2, fill = variant,
                    text = paste0(variant, "<br>", period, ": ", fmt_km2(km2),
                                  ifelse(variant == "v3.1 approximation",
                                         paste0(" (", fmt_pct(change), ")"), "")))) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.75,
           colour = bf_ink$surface, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("v3 (plantations counted as natural)" = bf_ink$other,
                               "v3.1 approximation" = measure_colors[["BF-NEE"]]),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_area, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))) +
  labs(title = "BF-NEE with and without plantations as natural ecosystems",
       x = NULL, y = "BF-NEE (km²)")

bf_interactive(p)
```

## Table

```{r}
global_period %>%
  transmute(Period = period, Countries = n_countries,
            `Unconstrained loss (km²)` = round(loss_unconstrained_km2),
            `Agricultural expansion (km²)` = round(agri_gain_km2),
            `Constrained loss (km²)` = round(loss_constrained_km2),
            `Share attributed` = round(share_attributed, 3),
            `BF-NEE (km²)` = round(bfnee_km2, 1),
            `BF-NEE without constraint (km²)` = round(bfnee_unconstrained_km2, 1)) %>%
  bf_table(page_length = 4)
```
